name: Salve via Disenchanting
label: Quest
description: Salve via Disenchanting: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates. I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve. You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work.
I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves. The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, friend. Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!
